name: Accord provisoire (Proposition de la Commission - non modifiée)
title: Deforestation Regulation: provisions relating to the date of application ***I
part_text:
The Commission is not changing any rules with this report. It is telling the European Parliament and the Council that it was given the power to update a list attached to a 2019 trade law, and that it never used that power. The list sets out special rules in trade deals with Singapore, Vietnam and Japan. The Commission simply asks the two institutions to note this.

- Nothing changes: no update to the list was made between 2019 and 2023.
- It affects trade with Singapore, Vietnam and Japan, and EU businesses trading there.
- The Commission will report again before the end of the next five-year period.
